transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... hi. I guess... I'm just here because I'm having a hard time keeping things straight. Like, I'm trying to do my schoolwork and... I have this little accessories shop, and I just can't seem to keep them organized at the same time. 

Everything just kind of ends up in these piles. My supplies, receipts, due dates, notes for my assignments... it all just piles up everywhere. And then I just... I don't really know what to do first. So, yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge when you're trying to manage your schoolwork and your shop?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. It's not really about feeling nervous or anything... it's just a lot to deal with, I guess.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about how well you're doing in school or with your shop, even when there's no clear reason to be concerned?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I want things to go okay, but I don't just sit around and worry about it if nothing's wrong. It's just... the piles and getting it all done. That's all.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or uninterested in things you usually enjoy, even when you’re not thinking about your schoolwork or the shop?
Um... no. I don't think so. I'm not sad or anything. I still like doing my stuff... it's just hard to keep up with it all. But no.
Do you find it hard to stay organized or keep track of things even when you're not working on school or the shop, like with personal items or daily tasks?

Um... I guess so? I don't really know. Things just get messy sometimes. I mean, it's just normal stuff, you know? I lose my keys or forget where I put my phone, but... I don't think it's that bad. Just normal.
Do you often find it hard to focus or stay on track with tasks, even when they aren't related to schoolwork or your shop, like when you're reading, watching something, or talking with friends?

Um... I don't really know about other stuff. I mostly just notice it when I'm in class, or... if I'm watching a video for my business assignments. 

I'll start out listening fine, but then... I don't know. After a few minutes, my mind is just on charm designs or... ideas for orders. And then I realize I missed half of what was said. So... yeah, I guess.
